title: Fix/boltz compability
body:
Small refractor, mostly splitting CashuPaymentService into MintHandler and MeltHandler.
Namespace cleanup.
Introduce PendingPaymentsProcessor, which monitors pending melt invoices. 
Now plugin returns 200 after succesfull token submit, not on transaction success.

title: Refactor code
body:
* Use primary ctor in `UICashuWalletController` and `CashuPaymentService`
* `UICashWalletController` wasn't properly checking `InputProofsJson` was null before assuming the `FailedTransaction` was old. Replaced the complicated calculation logic it used with switch pattern. Making sure invoice currency is BTC or SATS.
* Introduce `CashuOperationContext` in the `CashuPaymentService` so less parameters are passed around.
* Make all calculations using `LightMoney` rather than using math and rounding all around.
* Make `CashuPaymentMethodHandler` a resolvable type in CI, avoiding the need to fetch it from the Dictionary.
* Simplify the `PaymentModel` logic in the `CashuPaymentSerivice`

title: Do not hardcode Uris
body:
* The previous code wouldn't have worked on instances configured with a subpath for their btcpayserver with `ROOT_PATH`.
* It needlessly transmitted `storeId` back and forth.
* It was duplicating some checks that are already done in `ProcessPaymentAsync`
* Use `Money` type instead of ulong conversions.
